title: Authoritative Metric Provenance and Model Availability Audit

investigation_scope.target_paper: Zooming Out on Zooming In: Advancing Super-Resolution for Remote Sensing (arXiv:2311.18082v1)

task1_lpips_agreement_procedure.paper_claim: The reported LPIPS scores are converted to an accuracy, so with each of these metrics, higher is better (Table 2 caption, page 5).

supplementary_url_audit.updated_url_status: HTTP 200 OK (Content-Length: 1748394 bytes, 1.74 MB, verified via HTTP HEAD request)
supplementary_url_audit.download_status: NOT_DOWNLOADED (observed strict constraint against downloading external assets)

repository_code_audit.finding: The repository codebase only calculates raw VGG LPIPS distance and arithmetic mean; no LPIPS-to-accuracy post-processing conversion script was integrated into the repo.

task2_medium_esrgan_checkpoint_audit.target_model: ESRGAN Medium (~87M parameters, used in Table 2 method comparison)

availability_audit.conclusion: The authors published the training configuration (esrgan_larger1.yml) but never publicly released the pretrained weights for the 87M medium ESRGAN. The local 16.71M small checkpoint (experiments/esrgan_8S2.pth) is authentic but represents an independent small-scale baseline.

validation_split_definition.small_val_set_status: Officially curated urban regression subset; authentic but geographically biased towards high-density cities (population >= 50k within 5km radius).

preprocessing_and_metrics_protocol.cpsnr_search: [-8, +8] window, stride 2 (81 candidate offsets), per-channel brightness bias compensation
preprocessing_and_metrics_protocol.temporal_metadata: UNAVAILABLE (tile stacks lack acquisition dates and cloud percentages)
